goal: Close Recur discovery and diagnostic gaps observed while dogfooding the batt Blender project: absolute evidence references, completed current_slice diagnostics and recur-eventness skill discovery.
invariants: Core recur queries remain read-only: no map, layer, manifest, config or Eventness mutation.
Evidence manifests keep relative internal artifact paths; only the CLI reference argument may be absolute, and only when it resolves inside the -d evidence root.
Absolute or relative references escaping the evidence root remain rejected with a clear message.
A stale current_slice is never silently replaced; diagnostics may name ready slices but selection is not inferred.
Reveal capsules point to skills; they do not load or execute them.
Existing dispatch intelligence feedback (test_failed escalation, easy-success step-down, no escalation for provider/runtime errors) is out of scope and unchanged.
A failing baseline demonstrates each gap; it does not prove a fix or satisfy final acceptance.

observations: recur warp evidence C:\src\batt\animation\video-runs\...\media.evidence.json -d C:\src\batt failed: artifact must be a relative path within the evidence root; the same manifest checked when passed relatively.
recur warp show batt.research.architecture -d C:\src\batt reported 5/5 complete with warning: Declared current_slice 'definition' is no longer ready; selection not inferred.
recur reveal --type skill -d . in the Recur repository lists recur-expert, recur-warp and others but not recur-eventness, although recur-eventness/SKILL.md exists.

final_state.description: Agents dogfooding Recur on an external project can pass absolute evidence paths inside the root, understand why a declared current_slice is not selected, and discover recur-eventness through typed Reveal like the other repository skills.
required_observations: recur warp evidence accepts an absolute manifest path inside -d and reports the same status as its relative form.
Absolute paths outside -d and relative traversal remain rejected with a message naming the evidence root.
When the declared current_slice is already complete, the warning says so and names ready slices or states that no slices remain.
When the declared current_slice is pending but not ready, the warning names its unmet dependencies.
recur reveal --type skill lists recur-eventness with a resolved recur-eventness/SKILL.md pointer.
Focused tests and relevant existing Warp/Reveal regressions pass; docs and recur-expert guidance reflect the behavior.
